flavor_text.one_line: Law-bound high-elves of the forest-and-river, lords of a fallen golden age guarding the last star-groves.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Aelvaneth were the morning-lords of the deep woods, an ancient star-court realm of elder-houses whose golden age long predates the rise of Men. Pulled hardest of all elves toward Law, they keep the old rites and the arcane birthright in silver-leaf halls grown from living trees. Their fall was steep: where they once ruled whole forests they now hold scattered fastnesses, jealous of every glade, exterminating any who would take the wood - rival elves and the hated Xilvaneth above all.
